$comment: THE ARGUED EXCEPTIONS TO THE ZERO-SKIP CONTRACT.
A skipped browser test is a lane nobody is proving, so it is refused by
scripts/assert-no-conditional-e2e-skips.mjs unless it is named here with a
reason and the condition that ends it. This list may only ever shrink: a
row whose spec, line region or condition no longer matches fails the gate,
so a stale exception cannot outlive the skip it was written for.
A ROW ARGUES NAMED TESTS, NEVER A WHOLE FILE. The run gate
(scripts/assert-playwright-gate.mjs) used to read `file` alone and treat
every skipped test in a named spec as argued, so a new unargued test.skip
added to either spec below passed the law-pins run silently. `tests` is the
titles this row argues, and both gates require it: the source gate refuses
a title the spec no longer holds, and the run gate refuses a skipped test

allowed.reason: The Core Web Vitals lane is a three-hour throttled sweep over six routes, so it is owned by its own run rather than by every pull request. PUBMAX_CWV_RECORD writes perf/cwv-baseline.json; PUBMAX_CWV_SWEEP defends it.
allowed.ends: A scheduled job (or npm script) that sets PUBMAX_CWV_SWEEP=1 on a cadence the team acts on.
tests: records or defends every route's LCP, INP, CLS and the product timings
every measured route names a primary action to interact with

allowed.reason: The keyless e2e server holds no service-role key, so verifyCallerAuth answers unavailable and both the claim PUT and the recovery PATCH answer 503 by design. The alternative was a test-only bypass inside production auth code, which was refused.
allowed.ends: A real authenticated e2e lane with a service-role key (#1300). The journey is kept whole so it can be switched on that day.
tests: a signed-in host who lost the capability cookie recovers it on the Plan page
